fields.name: host
fields.description: Loki base hostname or IP address. Don't include the sub-path, only the base hostname or URL.

fields.name: uri
fields.description: Specify a custom HTTP URI. It must start with a forward slash (/).

fields.name: port
fields.description: The Loki TCP port.

fields.name: tls
fields.description: Use TLS authentication.

fields.name: http_user
fields.description: Set HTTP basic authentication user name.

fields.name: http_passwd
fields.description: Set HTTP basic authentication password.

fields.name: bearer_token
fields.description: Set bearer token authentication token value.

fields.name: header
fields.description: Add additional arbitrary HTTP header key/value pair. Multiple headers can be set.

fields.name: tenant_id
fields.description: Tenant ID used by default to push logs to Loki. If omitted or empty it assumes Loki is running in single-tenant mode and no X-Scope-OrgID header is sent.

fields.name: labels
fields.description: Stream labels for API request. It can be multiple comma separated of strings specifying key=value pairs. Allows fixed parameters, or adding custom record keys (similar to the label_keys property). See the Labels section.

fields.name: label_keys
fields.description: (Optional.) List of record keys that will be placed as stream labels. This configuration property is for records key only. See the Labels section.

fields.name: label_map_path
fields.description: Specify the label map path. The file defines how to extract labels from each record. See the Labels section.

fields.name: structured_metadata
fields.description: (Optional.) Comma-separated list of key=value strings specifying structured metadata for the log line. Like the labels parameter, values can reference record keys using record accessors. See Use structured_metadata..

fields.name: structured_metadata_map_keys
fields.description: (Optional.) Comma-separated list of record key strings specifying record values of type map, used to dynamically populate structured metadata for the log line. Values can only reference record keys using record accessors, which should reference map values. Each entry from the referenced map will be used to add an entry to the structured metadata. See Use structured_metadata..

fields.name: remove_keys
fields.description: (Optional.) List of keys to remove.

fields.name: drop_single_key
fields.description: When set to true and after extracting labels only a single key remains, the log line sent to Loki will be the value of that key in line_format. If set to raw and the log line is a string, the log line will be sent unquoted.

fields.name: line_format
fields.description: Format to use when flattening the record to a log line. Valid values are json or key_value. If set to json, the log line sent to Loki will be the Fluent Bit record dumped as JSON. If set to key_value, the log line will be each item in the record concatenated together (separated by a single space) in the format.

fields.name: auto_kubernetes_labels
fields.description: If set to true, adds all Kubernetes labels to the stream labels.

fields.name: tenant_id_key
fields.description: Specify the name of the key from the original record that contains the Tenant ID. The value of the key is set as X-Scope-OrgID of HTTP header. Use to set Tenant ID dynamically.

fields.name: buffer_size
fields.description: Maximum HTTP response buffer size.

fields.name: compress
fields.description: Set payload compression mechanism. The only available option is gzip.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of workers to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.
